exposure: high suspicion for MAP vs no risk factors for MAP
high suspicion for MAP (all three ultrasound findings) vs two or less ultrasound findings
absence of the retroplacental clear zone
risk factors for morbidly adherent placenta (MAP)
cohort: 41 women with placenta previa with or without risk factors for MAP
finding: Management of placenta previa with prediction of MAP by ultrasonography is useful for obtaining permissible morbidity.
mod_finding: This study on managing placenta previa with ultrasonography found no difference in blood loss between women with high suspicion of morbidly adherent placenta and those without risk, suggesting potential benefits for cesarean section planning in this context.
